title: Cumpleaños infantil — mejora de Birthday Adventure
brief: Improve the children's birthday guest invitation (birthday-adventure-01) for phones. Same eight content fields and the same five-color palettes (sunset, ocean, forest), so it can ship as a new renderer without changing the schema. Original artwork only.

artboards.title: Mapa de aventura
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps the adventure name and gives the details a playful route; more ornaments to build and maintain

artboards.title: Cartel de fiesta
artboards.tradeoff: Strongest first impression and a ticket that groups the details; the large accent band is loud and heavier to render

artboards.title: Cuento ilustrado
artboards.tradeoff: Calm, readable storybook that also suits parents; less party energy and a longer scroll
